description: This file is a React component named ScheduleICU that renders a weekly calendar UI for scheduling ICU rooms, including fetching data from API services, managing state, and handling user interactions such as opening a booking modal.

methods.name: ScheduleICU
methods.description: Main React functional component that displays a weekly ICU scheduling grid, fetches doctors and ICU room data, and manages modal interactions.

methods.name: handleCellClick
methods.description: Event handler invoked when a calendar cell is clicked; sets selected date/time and opens the booking modal.

methods.name: onSave
methods.description: Callback invoked when a booking is saved from the modal; currently just closes modal and logs payload.

methods.name: formatDate
methods.description: Utility to format Date objects into 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.
